entries.trigger: MultiMod attempts to alter or reinterpret continuous-moderation V1.
More than one additive MultiMod configuration is present in one recipe.
HOCs and groups are combined.
HOCs and case or frequency weights are combined.
Groups and weights are combined.
A three-way term and an HOC are combined.
More than one three-way term, incomplete lower-order closure, fourth-order or arbitrary k-way products are requested.
HOCs are nested, hybrid, overlapping or not pairwise-disjoint.
More than one HOC approach is used in one run.
Studentized inference is selected outside its bounded profile.
The complete delete-one jackknife is unavailable.
A less or greater alternative was not frozen before calculation.
A required shared ledger has too few usable draws.
An exact contiguous indirect path was not selected explicitly.
A scalar index is requested for a non-affine or multi-moderator indirect effect.
Raw-unit probing is requested for a composite or HOC moderator.
An observed raw-unit moderator has no transformation receipt.
Case weights are nonfinite, nonpositive or exceed the normalized 1e6 max/min ratio.
Frequencies are not positive integers or total more than 2^53-1.
Sampling weights, clusters, strata, PPS or survey-design claims are requested.
The grouping column is a model indicator.
Fewer than two or more than twenty selected typed groups remain.
A selected group has fewer than ten complete model cases.
The complete-case group imbalance is greater than 10:1.
The structured configural-invariance checklist is incomplete.
An affected construct lacks partial measurement invariance.
All 190 pairs at twenty groups are requested without heavy-run confirmation.
An omnibus K-group MICOM conclusion is requested.
A directional Henseler probability is labelled as an ordinary two-sided p-value.
A zero-acceleration bias-corrected interval is labelled as BCa.
Automatic class or segment count selection is requested.
Bootstrap attempts to repeat discovery or select K.
Fewer than two aligned starts reproduce the optimum within frozen tolerances.
A start has a material likelihood decrease.
A class collapses or a residual variance falls below 1e-8.
A weighted design is singular or a required value is nonfinite.
P2 or P23 is requested under the publication-faithful P0 method.
Fewer than two starts reproduce the canonical partition and objective.
Configural identity or required pairwise compositional invariance fails.
A fixed-K bootstrap label match is ambiguous or lacks majority overlap.
A latent, composite or HOC variable is assigned a causal-module role.
Groups or weights are requested in the causal module.
A natural, cross-world or recanting-witness estimand is requested.
Exposure-induced mediator-outcome confounding is present.
The explicit adjustment set is absent.
A required temporal-order or identification declaration is unreviewed.
Observed support is inadequate for the requested intervention.
Output claims that causality is established.
Predicted sidecar size exceeds 512 MiB for one run.
A sidecar is missing, altered, duplicated, schema-mismatched or identity-mismatched.
No exact release-qualified profile cell matches the request.
